roi_policy: Static bounding union of sampled API boxes, applied to every frame; offline VOD baseline, not tracking.
rate_definition: 8 * complete MP4 bytes / decoded CFR duration, in kbps; includes container overhead.
rate_control_note: CRF quality grid, not fixed-target-bitrate or matched-byte comparison. CRF is not a constant background QP. Actual bitrate is measured per candidate.
